schema.text: When the service is late or unreliable, what do you do?

options.text: I leave earlier, just in case
I change route or travel time
I don't rely on it for important trips
I use another way of travelling instead
I have no alternative: I wait, sometimes for a long time
I arrive late for work, school or appointments
It doesn't change what I do

it.#When the service is late or unreliable,: Quando il servizio è in ritardo o poco affidabile, cosa fai?
it.#I don't rely on it for important trips: Non ci faccio affidamento per gli spostamenti importanti
it.#I have no alternative: I wait, sometime: Non ho alternative: aspetto, anche a lungo
it.#I arrive late for work, school or appoi: Arrivo in ritardo al lavoro, a scuola o agli appuntamenti

fr.#When the service is late or unreliable,: Quand le service est en retard ou peu fiable, que faites-vous ?
fr.#I leave earlier, just in case: Je pars plus tôt, au cas où
fr.#I don't rely on it for important trips: Je ne compte pas dessus pour les trajets importants
fr.#I use another way of travelling instead: J'utilise un autre moyen de transport à la place
fr.#I have no alternative: I wait, sometime: Je n'ai pas d'alternative : j'attends, parfois longtemps
fr.#I arrive late for work, school or appoi: J'arrive en retard au travail, à l'école ou à mes rendez-vous
fr.#It doesn't change what I do: Cela ne change rien à ce que je fais

de.#When the service is late or unreliable,: Was tun Sie, wenn der Dienst verspätet oder unzuverlässig ist?
de.#I don't rely on it for important trips: Auf wichtigen Wegen verlasse ich mich nicht darauf
de.#I use another way of travelling instead: Ich nutze stattdessen ein anderes Verkehrsmittel
de.#I have no alternative: I wait, sometime: Ich habe keine Alternative: Ich warte, manchmal lange
de.#I arrive late for work, school or appoi: Ich komme zu spät zur Arbeit, zur Schule oder zu Terminen
de.#It doesn't change what I do: Es ändert nichts an dem, was ich tue

tr.#When the service is late or unreliable,: Hizmet geciktiğinde veya güvenilmez olduğunda ne yaparsınız?
tr.#I leave earlier, just in case: Ne olur ne olmaz diye daha erken çıkarım
tr.#I use another way of travelling instead: Bunun yerine başka bir ulaşım yolu kullanırım
tr.#I have no alternative: I wait, sometime: Başka seçeneğim yok: bazen uzun süre bekliyorum
tr.#I arrive late for work, school or appoi: İşe, okula veya randevulara geç kalıyorum

fa.#When the service is late or unreliable,: وقتی سرویس دیر می‌کند یا قابل‌اعتماد نیست، چه می‌کنید؟
fa.#I change route or travel time: مسیر یا زمان سفر را تغییر می‌دهم
fa.#I don't rely on it for important trips: برای سفرهای مهم به آن تکیه نمی‌کنم
fa.#I use another way of travelling instead: به جای آن از روش دیگری استفاده می‌کنم
fa.#I have no alternative: I wait, sometime: جایگزینی ندارم: منتظر می‌مانم، گاهی برای مدت طولانی
fa.#I arrive late for work, school or appoi: دیر به محل کار، مدرسه یا قرارهایم می‌رسم

hu.#When the service is late or unreliable,: Ha a járat késik, vagy megbízhatatlan, mit tesz?
hu.#I change route or travel time: Megváltoztatom az útvonalat vagy az utazás idejét
hu.#I have no alternative: I wait, sometime: Nincs más lehetőségem: várok, néha sokáig
hu.#I arrive late for work, school or appoi: Elkésem a munkából, az iskolából vagy a megbeszélt időpontokról

ar.#When the service is late or unreliable,: عندما تتأخر الخدمة أو لا يُعتمد عليها، ما تصرّفك؟
ar.#I don't rely on it for important trips: لا أعتمد عليها في الرحلات المهمة
ar.#I use another way of travelling instead: أستخدم وسيلة تنقل أخرى بدلًا منها
ar.#I have no alternative: I wait, sometime: ليس لدي بديل: أنتظر، أحيانًا لفترة طويلة
ar.#I arrive late for work, school or appoi: أتأخر في الوصول إلى العمل أو المدرسة أو المواعيد
